correctness.rationale: Universal alternating-Pfaffian kernel relation Bw=0 gives exact differential of Q(w) in all coefficient variables. Each generator of the square of the principal Pfaffian ideal occurs as a coefficient partial; F already lies in this square. Local symplectic block reduction at polar corank 3 identifies three transverse coordinates and Artin quotient of length 4. Irreducibility of F follows from primitive linearity in diagonal coefficients and codimension-three common Pfaffian zeros. Standalone exact symbolic tests at odd orders 3, 5, 7 check all claimed polynomial identities.

value.rationale: Uniform identification of the complete nonreduced Jacobian scheme of a natural classical projective dual for every even dimension at least four is a structural determination, not a choice of ad hoc parameters. The global square-Pfaffian ideal and generic transverse length-four invariant reveal infinitesimal geometry invisible from polar rank or dual degree alone, and guide studies of singularities of positive-characteristic duals.
